payload.summary: Follow-up flagged, NOT yet fixed: the same shared-$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID gap that caused duplicate cowork-cron registrations also defeats the P3 fire-election RE-ENTRANT branch (task_claim 'claimed:false + current_holder.owner_client_session==$SID => treat as re-entrant, proceed'). Two sibling CLI processes sharing one session UUID would BOTH treat each other's live claim as their own re-entrant hold and BOTH proceed -- a genuine double-dispatch risk, not just wasted registration overhead. Blast radius: docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/leader-lock.md, docs/agents/dev-team/flow/main.md Step [3] fire-election, all 3 system-auditor tier crons, and the router's own .claude/skills/dispatch-claim/CARD.md Phase B re-entrant branch (5+ files). Out of scope for the bounded 2-file cowork-registration fix already signalled to agent-father (docs/signals/2026-08-15-cowork-cron-registration-sibling-process-defer.json) -- needs PO to scope/prioritize as a separate follow-up task, given the blast radius includes the router's own hot path.
